name: Frozen Orb Local Delay Example
author: Reimagined Launcher
description: Dropdown example: choose how Frozen Orb's localdelay (skills.txt) is set. 'Fixed (300)' also lowers Blizzard and Meteor localdelay to 150; 'Custom' lets you type a value and (for testing) bundles the Aura Spirits plugin.

parameters.name: Frozen Orb Local Delay
parameters.description: How to set Frozen Orb's localdelay column. 'Unchanged' makes no edit, 'Fixed (300)' writes 300, 'Custom' writes the value you type below.

parameters.name: Custom Local Delay
parameters.description: The localdelay value written to Frozen Orb when the dropdown is set to 'Custom'. Only shown while 'Custom' is selected.

parameters.name: Also apply Aura Spirits (test)
parameters.description: When enabled, the bundled Aura Spirits changes are applied alongside the custom Frozen Orb delay. Only shown while 'Custom' is selected.
